summary: No company-specific catalyst confirmed. 60d gain tracks ETH rebound from ~$1,560 (Jun 30) to ~$2,450 early Sep (+56% in Aug) and ~$2,690 by Sep 20. Aug 10 Q2 report: EPS -$1.88, $76M impairment; $125M Galaxy yield fund.

dilution_or_offering: $75M registered direct offering late June 2026 funded ETH buys; also ongoing share buybacks.
